cards.back: England. Constituent country of the United Kingdom.
Scotland. Constituent country of the United Kingdom.
Wales. Constituent country of the United Kingdom.
Greenland. Constituent country in the Kingdom of Denmark.
Czech Republic. Also known as Czechia.
Faroe Islands. Constituent country in the Kingdom of Denmark.
North Macedonia. Formerly known as Macedonia.
Cape Verde. Also known as Cabo Verde.
Democratic Republic of the Congo. Formerly Zaire.
Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic. Partially recognised state claimed by Morocco. Also known as Western Sahara.
Hong Kong. Special Administrative Region of China.
Taiwan. Partially recognised state claimed by China.
Guam. Unincorporated territory of the United States.
Puerto Rico. Unincorporated territory of the United States.
French Polynesia. Overseas territory of France.
Kosovo. Partially recognised state claimed by Serbia.
Curaçao. Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
Macau. Special Administrative Region of China.
New Caledonia. Overseas territory of France.
Northern Cyprus. State recognised only by Turkey and claimed by Cyprus.
Somaliland. Independent state claimed by Somalia.
United States Virgin Islands. Unincorporated territory of the United States.
Åland Islands. Autonomous region of Finland.
South Ossetia. Independent state claimed by Georgia.
Aruba. Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
Abkhazia. Independent state claimed by Georgia.
Transnistria. Independent state claimed by Moldova.
